set_aside.subject: disaster-recovery import material
set_aside.text: “the owner keeps the export file and the picks, names and aliases given in the import until a checked backup holds the import” contradicts “Other services keep no customer record and no copy of these values” and the stated exceptions limited to issued documents and Client Portal's offline projection
set_aside.question: Is the retained export and import-input record a temporary exception to the one-home rule, and what named store and trust boundary hold and then erase them?
options: A temporary owner-controlled recovery store is an explicit exception
The material remains only on the legacy VPS and is not copied elsewhere
Only a minimized recovery record without personal values is retained
No recovery material is retained outside Registry
set_aside.default_guess: Treat it as a temporary encrypted owner-controlled recovery store, explicitly except it from R0-80, and erase it after a checked backup holds the import.

set_aside.subject: legacy VPS retirement
set_aside.text: “They hold real personal data, are administered by the owner and stand outside this document's guarantees. The VPS one is the migration's only source; each is retired once the migration is done (R0-79).” contradicts “retires the VPS instance only then”, where “then” means after a checked backup holds the import
set_aside.question: Does “migration is done” mean successful import, or successful import followed by a checked backup that contains it?
options: Retire only after the checked backup contains the import
Retire the instance after import but preserve its store until the checked backup
set_aside.default_guess: Define migration completion to include a checked backup containing the import, and retire the VPS only afterward.

set_aside.subject: replaying retention-review changes after restore
set_aside.text: “What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner's own record of the retention review”
set_aside.question: Exactly which lost actions must be replayed: customer-contact erasure, project anonymisation or deletion, audit-entry erasure, applying or lifting restrictions, ending or resuming relationships, and in what order when their current preconditions differ after restore?
options: Replay every retention-review state change recorded after the backup
Replay only erasures, applying restrictions and ending relationships
Replay only actions the owner re-evaluates as still required after restore
set_aside.default_guess: Replay every recorded retention-review state change lost after the backup, in original order, re-evaluating only actions whose recorded preconditions no longer hold.
